summary.overview: Customer reported login intermittently failing on Safari. Also requested CSV export for reports.

sentences.text: Thanks for jumping on. We've been using the platform for a few months now and overall it's been great.
So the main issue we keep hitting is that users are getting logged out randomly, especially on Safari. It happens maybe twice a week.
Got it, that sounds frustrating. Can you tell me more about when it happens?
It seems random — they're just in the middle of working and get kicked back to the login page.
Understood, I'll flag that to the team right away.
Also, it would be nice if we could export our reports as CSV, not just PDF. Our finance team needs to pull the numbers into Excel.
That's a reasonable ask, I'll put that on the roadmap.
Great, looking forward to it. Overall we're happy with the product.
